title: Coding Team BE-to-FE Handoff
description: Handoff manifest from Backend implementation step to Frontend implementation step. FE agent must not proceed without a valid instance of this schema.

be_changes_path.description: Relative path to the impl/be_changes/ directory containing all backend implementation files.

api_contracts.description: List of API endpoints implemented by Backend that Frontend must consume. Static-only projects may provide an empty array.

response_shape.description: Description or JSON schema of response body.

shared_types.description: Data types shared between Backend and Frontend (DTOs, enums, etc.).

scope_constraints.description: Explicit list of what Backend did NOT implement. Frontend must not assume these are available.
